name: grok-canvas
description: 在无限画布上使用 Grok 生成、连接和迭代图片与视频。

scripts.test: pnpm test:ui && pnpm test:generation && pnpm test:auth && pnpm test:video && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:workspace && pnpm test:agent && pnpm test:commands && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:planning
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k -s first -n next,electron "pnpm dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3210 && electron . --dev"
scripts.desktop:bundle: pnpm desktop:prepare && pnpm desktop:deps && pnpm desktop:finish
scripts.desktop:build: pnpm build && pnpm desktop:bundle && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.test:generation: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/generation-record.test.mjs tests/generation-details.test.mjs tests/generation-registry.test.mjs tests/generation-claims.test.mjs tests/multi-image.test.mjs tests/generation-batch.test.mjs
scripts.test:video: node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/video-references.test.mjs tests/video-request.test.mjs tests/video-tasks.test.mjs tests/video-route.test.mjs tests/video-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:workspace: node --test tests/workspace-preferences.test.mjs tests/account-display.test.mjs tests/canvas-interaction.test.mjs tests/canvas-performance.test.mjs tests/usage.test.mjs tests/canvas-library.test.mjs tests/canvas-references.test.mjs tests/canvas-store.test.mjs tests/canvas-operations.test.mjs tests/canvas-route.test.mjs tests/canvas-persistence.test.mjs tests/asset-upload.test.mjs tests/prompt-editor.test.mjs tests/asset-drag.test.mjs tests/desktop-runtime.test.mjs tests/desktop-bridge.test.mjs
scripts.test:commands: node --test tests/command-schema.test.mjs tests/canvas-entity-store.test.mjs tests/canvas-commands.test.mjs tests/canvas-history-leases.test.mjs tests/canvas-outbox.test.mjs
